summary: Layer 1B expansion finds one direct MLCC/passives reference name and three US-listed underfollowed or lower-attention candidates tied to board-level power delivery, front-end/datacenter power, magnetics, capacitors, inductors, and power semiconductors. The strongest direct node fit is Murata via AI-server MLCC intensity, but it is an OTC ADR reference leader rather than a small/mid-cap alpha candidate. The underfollowed lane is more speculative: Vishay has broad passive-component and power-discrete exposure with explicit AI/electrification capacity investment but needs proof of high-end AI-server MLCC qualification; Vicor has explicit AI accelerator and hyperscaler power-delivery exposure; Bel Fuse has datacenter front-end power, DC-DC converters, racks/shelves, magnetics, and networking demand evidence but needs clearer AI-server customer mix.
